title: Marvel Studios 10 Years of crappy items and no Stan Lee!
text:
As soon as I heard it is Marvel Studios 10 Years box I thought this for sure will have awesome Marvel goods. Gold hulk PEZ!! gold pint size heroes you get Thor and Thanos... painting figures gold doesn't make them better!... No shirt! As for the pop you get movie moment iron man vs whats his name... Out of all the cool movie moment in marvel this is what we get!! They had a great chance of making this a great box. Not 1 item was good in this box. This is not celebrating Marvel Studios 10 Years. This is the worst box ever. I unsubscribed.

I personally would have love if they put Stan Lee in this box since he died before the release of this box.
label: negative
